mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have foggy conditions and a temperature of 60 degrees out near the Military Ridge State Trail.

City updates include a police investigation involving a former school staff member following an arrest made on September 4. Additionally, road work on Highway M continues, with traffic shifting south into the eastbound lanes for phase two construction starting the week of September 7.

Today you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, tomorrow is packed with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown Farmer's Market on September 9, and live music at Bailey's Run on September 11.

The Verona Police Department released information regarding an arrest of a Madison resident for an incident that occurred on Sunday, August 30, involving an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and student from 2019.
It is a delicious day for Georgia Peach ice cream, and the store will be ready for you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
